Experience the Transformation of West Patna from Above!
Take a cinematic journey over one of Patna's fastest-growing corridors. In this 4K drone footage, we capture the breathtaking aerial view of the stretch from Gola Road to Saguna Mor (Danapur).
As of March 2026, this area has become the heartbeat of New Patna. Witness the massive progress of the Patna Metro Red Line and the ongoing expansion of Nehru Path (Bailey Road) into a world-class 8-lane corridor designed to decongest traffic toward Danapur Station and Bihta.
